author: romakkans
quote: Hey, Zelnik, T2, and Rockstar—people really don’t like it when "smart alecks" like you take them for fools. 99 out of 100? Fine—now we know exactly which publications sold off their reputations. It’s clearly not a "99 out of 100" game; it’s obviously nowhere near the best game out there. It’s just boring—yet another dull *GTA* title based on the "entertain yourself" principle. I’m glad I didn’t pre-order and decided to try it out at a friend’s place instead. You won’t get another cent from me. Damn you all—you spent less money on the actual development than you did on advertising and paying off those unscrupulous journalists. damn you..
